doc_notes: This document consists of two news articles from 1987 discussing the debunking of the Majestic 12 (MJ-12) documents by the Committee for the Scientific Investigation of Claims of the Paranormal.

incidents.summary: Alleged crash of a flying saucer and recovery of four alien bodies in 1947.
incidents.explanation: Determined to be a clumsy counterfeit by the Committee for the Scientific Investigation of Claims of the Paranormal.
incidents.quote: the Pentagon recovered a crashed flying saucer and the bodies of four alien creatures in 1947
